Class CardRoundController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Client.UI.GUI.SceneControllers.GUIController
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Client.UI.GUI.SceneControllers.CardRoundController
public class CardRoundController extends GUIController
The CardRoundController class is responsible for managing the interaction and behavior of all GUI elements during the card round phase of the game. It includes methods to initialize and update graphical components, handle user interactions, and manage player actions related to game cards.
